message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a weekday and gives you a 3‑day break that includes the adjacent Saturday and/or Sunday.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if shifted) | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Observed Mon Jan 2 | Creates a long weekend from Sat Jan 1–Mon Jan 2 |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba, etc.) | Feb 20 (Mon) | – | Long weekend Sat Feb 18–Mon Feb 20 |
| **Good Friday** | Mar 31 (Fri) | – | Long weekend Fri Mar 31–Sun Apr 2 |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | – | Long weekend Sat May 20–Mon May 22 |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Sat) | Observed Mon Jul 3 | Long weekend Sat Jul 1–Mon Jul 3 |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | – | Long weekend Sat Sep 2–Mon Sep 4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | – | Long weekend Sat Oct 7–Mon Oct 9 |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Sat) | Observed Mon Nov 13 | Long weekend Sat Nov 11–Mon Nov 13 |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Mon) | – | Long weekend Sat Dec 23–Mon Dec 25 |

> **Quick recap**  
> • 9 long weekends in total.  
> • Some holidays (e.g., Canada Day, Remembrance Day) were observed on a Monday because the actual date fell on a weekend.  
> • Boxing Day (Dec 26) fell on a Tuesday, so it did **not** create a long weekend.  

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.) or a more detailed breakdown, let me know.
